lines.t: I've prayed night and day asking you to take these things away
That are dragging me down
Help clean this filth from my soul
Make me pure and make me whole
Take away these things in my heart
That have been trying to pull me away from the start
Burn away the draws that's been covering me up
Claim me Lord, come sweep my heart
Leave not a corner where the dust can't stop
Make me worthy for you
Help me put all this impurity away
Until only pure faith remains
Whispers in the wind
Saying come with us in sin
And you'll feel good again
And I used to believe their lies
But now they're my despise
Help me put away the sins I did
Help me face the wrong from which I hid
Lord, wash me till I'm clean
Scrub off all the mean
Burn away the drought that's recurring me
Oh, clean me, Lord, come sweep my heart
Leave not a corner where the dust can't start
Make me worthy for you
Help me put all this impurity away
Until only pure faith remains
You're gonna find me, clean me, wipe the filth from my soul
Burn away the trials and all my sins of yesterday
Make me new in your love, help clean me today
I've walked through the dust, tried doing it all on my own
But you meet me right where I'm standing
And call this tired heart back home
Thank you.
